what: From-scratch regression of the 186 main terms (program 1): code/oai186_IH.py --out and code/oai186_J.py --out re-run on a fresh machine (256 bits; 355 s and 1141 s, one core each) and compared field by field with the committed code/oai186_IH.json and code/oai186_J.json.
scope: Program 1 only (the second program code/oai186_check2.py was not re-run). Covers the main terms I_H and J_lambda of the 186 companion, not the loss bound L+ and not the analytic inputs of the 186 preprint, which are not verified.
